From 8bd719587d1215dad42d48d725eb1858987112c8 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Marta Lofstedt <marta.lofstedt@intel.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Aug 2017 15:18:10 +0300
Subject: [PATCH] drm/i915: Beef up of Beef up the IPS vs. CRC workaround
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8
Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit

Commit 6e644626945c ("drm/i915: Beef up the IPS vs. CRC
workaround") was supposed to solve below bug. However, the
patch I tested is not the same as the one that got merged.
With this addition the test pass.

V2: removed unused: "struct intel_crtc *intel_crtc"

Fixes: 6e644626945c ("drm/i915: Beef up the IPS vs. CRC workaround")
Bugzilla: https://bugs.freedesktop.org/show_bug.cgi?id=101664
Signed-off-by: Marta Lofstedt <marta.lofstedt@intel.com>
Signed-off-by: Ville Syrjälä <ville.syrjala@linux.intel.com>
Link: https://patchwork.freedesktop.org/patch/msgid/20170828121810.13112-1-marta.lofstedt@intel.com

diff --git a/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/intel_pipe_crc.c b/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/intel_pipe_crc.c
index 4e22bb927fed..96043a51c1bf 100644
--- a/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/intel_pipe_crc.c
+++ b/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/intel_pipe_crc.c
@@ -919,7 +919,6 @@ int intel_crtc_set_crc_source(struct drm_crtc *crtc, const char *source_name,
 {
 	struct drm_i915_private *dev_priv = crtc->dev->dev_private;
 	struct intel_pipe_crc *pipe_crc = &dev_priv->pipe_crc[crtc->index];
-	struct intel_crtc *intel_crtc = to_intel_crtc(crtc);
 	enum intel_display_power_domain power_domain;
 	enum intel_pipe_crc_source source;
 	u32 val = 0; /* shut up gcc */
@@ -951,8 +950,6 @@ int intel_crtc_set_crc_source(struct drm_crtc *crtc, const char *source_name,
 		else if ((IS_HASWELL(dev_priv) ||
 			  IS_BROADWELL(dev_priv)) && crtc->index == PIPE_A)
 			hsw_pipe_A_crc_wa(dev_priv, false);
-
-		hsw_enable_ips(intel_crtc);
 	}
 
 	pipe_crc->skipped = 0;
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/gpu/drm/i915/intel_pipe_crc.c`**
   - **Removed Line**: The line that initializes `struct intel_crtc *intel_crtc` has been removed.
   - **Removed Function Call**: The call to `hsw_enable_ips(intel_crtc);` has also been removed from the function `intel_crtc_set_crc_source`.

### Relationships Between Modifications

The modifications in the `intel_pipe_crc.c` file are aimed at refining the workaround for the IPS vs. CRC issue. By removing the unused `intel_crtc` structure and the associated function call, the patch simplifies the code and potentially resolves the bug referenced in the commit message. This change is a follow-up to a previous commit (6e644626945c) that attempted to address the same issue, indicating that the initial solution was not fully effective and required further adjustment. The removal of these lines suggests a more streamlined approach to handling the CRC source setting without unnecessary complexity.

```c
-	struct intel_crtc *intel_crtc = to_intel_crtc(crtc);
-	hsw_enable_ips(intel_crtc);
```
Reason:
The removal of the `intel_crtc` structure and the call to `hsw_enable_ips(intel_crtc)` indicates that the power state management for the IPS feature was not being handled correctly. This could lead to improper CRC handling when IPS was enabled, causing inconsistencies and failures in tests that relied on CRC functionality.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
+	hsw_enable_ips(intel_crtc);
```
Reason:
Reintroducing the call to `hsw_enable_ips(intel_crtc)` ensures that the IPS feature is correctly managed when setting the CRC source. This helps maintain the expected behavior of the graphics driver, ensuring that the CRC functionality works properly in conjunction with the IPS feature, thus resolving the inconsistencies that led to test failures.

        Root cause:
        The bug was related to the interaction between the IPS (Intelligent Power Savings) feature and the CRC (Cyclic Redundancy Check) functionality in the Intel graphics driver. The initial workaround introduced in commit 6e644626945c did not fully address the issue, leading to failures in tests that relied on proper CRC handling when IPS was enabled. The removal of the unused `intel_crtc` structure and the `hsw_enable_ips(intel_crtc);` function call indicates that the previous implementation may have been incorrectly managing the power state or CRC source settings, causing inconsistencies in behavior.
